proposed_read_only_tuning.comparison: Exact26RO fields and ordering from core mmc_compare_ext_csds; compare core-decoded values, plus actual HS_TIMING==(3|drive_strength<<4) and BUS_WIDTH==6 (non-ES). Fresh512B DMA everytrial; no unverified first-read reference.
proposed_read_only_tuning.window_policy: start with64 linear taps,20successfulreads per passingtap,min12; center16readverification, no63-to0wrap assumption
proposed_read_only_tuning.data_gate: Non-data coreCMD6/CMD13 transitions remain allowed. UnverifiedHS200 allows onlyselectedCMD21; unverifiedHS400 onlyselectedCMD8; transientDDR52 blocks allordinarydata. Poison+shapechecks preventwrongopcode/write bypass.
proposed_read_only_tuning.failure: Retain bounded cleanup, DMA quarantine and allocation safety. Use separately reviewed v23 card-error classification for expected bad-tap CRC/timeout; unknown/fatal bits remain errors. Return failure and use preserved accepted boot fallback; no unreviewed manual CMD6 downgrade
proposed_read_only_tuning.writes: No raw-sector or scratch writes needed for tuning; lateruser-authorizedfilesystemintegrity tests validatewritepath
proposed_read_only_tuning.abort: CMD13 has no data to abort. CMD8 uses explicit zero-retry CMD12; mmc_send_abort_tuning(CMD8) would be a no-op and is not used.
proposed_read_only_tuning.deadline: Separate30s softdeadline perCMD/DS phase includingcenterverification;200ms commands; boundedcleanup mayextenddeadline.
